_about: Scenario presets for Research Gap Intelligence. Every value is a TARGET with an origin. 'curated_assumption' values are PyroLens demonstration assumptions, not official specifications: no document in this collection states them. Fields left out are unknown and must not be filled with defaults.

oxygen_mole_fraction.note: Nominal air-like cabin atmosphere; demonstration assumption.

total_pressure.note: Nominal sea-level-equivalent cabin pressure; demonstration assumption.

oxygen_mole_fraction.note: Demonstration assumption (34 % O2). Exploration-atmosphere studies discuss values in this range; no document in this collection states it, so it is not presented as a mission specification.

total_pressure.note: Demonstration assumption (8.2 psi). Not verified against an authoritative mission document in this collection.

diluent.note: Demonstration assumption: nitrogen balance gas. Not verified against an authoritative mission document in this collection.

flow_configuration.note: Demonstration assumption: ventilation flow along a fabric surface in the direction of flame spread.

flow_velocity.note: Demonstration assumption for cabin ventilation order of magnitude; not a ventilation specification.

material.note: Demonstration assumption: cotton-fiberglass fabric (SIBAL) as a representative crew-cabin textile.

gravity.note: Free flight between planets (no rotation assumed).
